description: Updates selected profile fields or shared assistant notes in the connected organisation. Requires moderator rights and write consent. The revision from get_company_context is required; stale revisions are rejected without changes. Omitted fields remain unchanged; notes replaces the complete shared notes text and empty strings clear fields. applicant_name updates the legal applicant setting and names an unnamed workspace; it does not rename an established workspace. Returns the saved context and new revision. Does not create or publish a Strategy.

applicant_name.description: Legal applicant name; empty clears it

notes.description: Complete replacement for shared Markdown notes; preserve unrelated notes

website.description: HTTP(S) website without credentials; empty clears it

name: update_company_context
title: Update company context
